name: publicrecords--ashby-jobs-scraper
description:
Ashby Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date. Scrape open jobs from any Ashby job board and return only postings published since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d). Title, location, department, compensation, URL, description.

When to use: Use when you need open jobs from companies that hire on Ashby, optionally only those posted since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d).

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/ashby-jobs-scraper

arguments.name: companies
arguments.desc: The name in the board URL: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ . One per line, or paste the URLs. Example: ["ramp","linear"]

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Return only postings published on or after this point. A window like 24h, 7d, 2w, or an ISO date/time such as 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z. Leave empty for every open posting. Example: "30d"

arguments.name: maxResults
arguments.desc: Cap on postings returned across all companies, newest first. Each returned posting is one billable result.

arguments.name: includeDescription
arguments.desc: Add the plain-text job description to every posting.

name: publicrecords--smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper
description:
SmartRecruiters Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date. Scrape open jobs from any SmartRecruiters careers site and return only postings released since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d). Title, location, department, URL, description.

When to use: Use when you need open jobs from companies that hire on SmartRecruiters, optionally only those released since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d).

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/smartrecruiters-jobs-scraper

arguments.name: companies
arguments.desc: The identifier in the careers URL: https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/ . One per line, or paste the URLs. Note: SmartRecruiters answers an unknown identifier with an empty list, so check spelling if you get zero postings. Example: ["Ubisoft2","smartrecruiters"]

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Return only postings published on or after this point. A window like 24h, 7d, 2w, or an ISO date/time such as 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z. Leave empty for every open posting. Example: "30d"

arguments.name: maxResults
arguments.desc: Cap on postings returned across all companies, newest first. Each returned posting is one billable result.

arguments.name: includeDescription
arguments.desc: Add the plain-text job description to every posting. SmartRecruiters needs one extra request per returned posting for this.
